destination_translations.headline: A city among the mountains
destination_translations.intro: Viewpoints, architecture and cloud forests meet in this Colombian Coffee Region city, built across the slopes of the Central Andes.
destination_translations.meta_description: Explore Manizales: its cathedral, Chipre, Herveo Tower and Andean forest reserves. A guide to the capital of Caldas.

destination_translations.headline: Una ciudad entre montañas
destination_translations.intro: Miradores, arquitectura y bosques de niebla se encuentran en esta ciudad del Eje Cafetero, construida sobre las laderas de la cordillera Central.
destination_translations.meta_description: Descubre Manizales: su catedral, Chipre, la Torre de Herveo y reservas de bosque andino. Una guía para conocer la capital de Caldas.

destination_translations.headline: Uma cidade entre montanhas
destination_translations.intro: Mirantes, arquitetura e florestas de neblina se encontram nesta cidade do Eixo Cafeeiro colombiano, construída nas encostas da cordilheira Central.
destination_translations.meta_description: Conheça Manizales: sua catedral, Chipre, a Torre de Herveo e reservas de floresta andina. Um guia pela capital de Caldas.

destination_story_translations.body: Founded in 1849 during the settlement of the region by migrants from Antioquia, Manizales grew around mountain routes and coffee farming. Trade and the former cableway to Mariquita connected its hillsides with other regions.

Fundada en 1849 durante la colonización antioqueña, Manizales creció entre caminos de montaña y cultivos de café. El comercio y el antiguo cable hacia Mariquita conectaron sus laderas con otras regiones.

Fundada em 1849 durante a colonização antioquenha, Manizales cresceu entre caminhos de montanha e plantações de café. O comércio e o antigo transporte por cabo até Mariquita conectaram suas encostas a outras regiões.

Its centre preserves buildings erected after the fires of the early twentieth century. The cathedral, cultural institutions and university life are part of a city shaped by steep slopes and Andean forests.

Su centro conserva edificios levantados después de los incendios de comienzos del siglo XX. La catedral, las instituciones culturales y la vida universitaria forman parte de una ciudad que convive con pendientes pronunciadas y bosques andinos.

Seu centro preserva edifícios construídos após os incêndios do início do século XX. A catedral, as instituições culturais e a vida universitária fazem parte de uma cidade marcada por encostas íngremes e florestas andinas.

destination_reason_translations.body: Look out over the city and mountains from Chipre.
Contemplar la ciudad y las montañas desde Chipre.
Contemplar a cidade e as montanhas a partir de Chipre.
Explore architectural heritage and the history of the former cableway.
Reconocer su patrimonio arquitectónico y la historia del antiguo cable.
Conhecer o patrimônio arquitetônico e a história do antigo transporte por cabo.
Discover cloud forest through managed nature visits.
Acercarse al bosque de niebla en visitas de naturaleza administradas.
Explorar a floresta de neblina em visitas de natureza administradas.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary
point_of_interest_translations.description: Its towers and neo-Gothic architecture define central Manizales, opposite Plaza de Bolívar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Catedral Basílica de Nuestra Señora del Rosario
point_of_interest_translations.description: Sus torres y su arquitectura neogótica marcan el centro de Manizales, frente a la Plaza de Bolívar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Catedral Basílica de Nossa Senhora do Rosário
point_of_interest_translations.description: Suas torres e a arquitetura neogótica marcam o centro de Manizales, diante da Plaza de Bolívar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Chipre and the Colonizers Monument
point_of_interest_translations.description: A hillside viewpoint district whose sculptural ensemble recalls the journeys and efforts of the region’s early settlers.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Chipre y Monumento a los Colonizadores
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un sector de miradores donde el conjunto escultórico recuerda los viajes y esfuerzos de quienes poblaron estas montañas.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Chipre e Monumento aos Colonizadores
point_of_interest_translations.description: Uma região de mirantes onde o conjunto de esculturas recorda as viagens e os esforços de quem povoou estas montanhas.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Herveo Tower and El Cable
point_of_interest_translations.description: This timber lattice tower preserves the history of the cableway that once connected Manizales with Mariquita.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Torre de Herveo y El Cable
point_of_interest_translations.description: El entramado de madera de esta torre conserva la memoria del transporte por cable que conectó Manizales con Mariquita.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Torre de Herveo e El Cable
point_of_interest_translations.description: A estrutura de madeira desta torre preserva a memória do transporte por cabo que ligava Manizales a Mariquita.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Recinto del Pensamiento
point_of_interest_translations.description: Gardens and Andean woodland surround this nature and environmental education venue. Visits depend on its programme and admission conditions.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Recinto del Pensamiento
point_of_interest_translations.description: Jardines y bosque andino rodean este espacio de naturaleza y educación ambiental. La visita depende de su programación y condiciones de ingreso.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Recinto del Pensamiento
point_of_interest_translations.description: Jardins e floresta andina cercam este espaço de natureza e educação ambiental. A visita depende da programação e das condições de entrada.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Río Blanco Reserve
point_of_interest_translations.description: Cloud forest protecting water and wildlife near the city. Managed visits require advance booking.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Reserva Río Blanco
point_of_interest_translations.description: Bosque de niebla que protege agua y biodiversidad cerca de la ciudad. Sus visitas administradas requieren reserva previa.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Reserva Río Blanco
point_of_interest_translations.description: Floresta de neblina que protege a água e a biodiversidade perto da cidade. As visitas administradas exigem reserva antecipada.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Los Yarumos Ecopark
point_of_interest_translations.description: An urban forest with trails and environmental education spaces in northeastern Manizales.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Ecoparque Los Yarumos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un bosque urbano con senderos y espacios de educación ambiental en el nororiente de Manizales.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Ecoparque Los Yarumos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Uma floresta urbana com trilhas e espaços de educação ambiental no nordeste de Manizales.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Nevado del Ruiz excursion
point_of_interest_translations.description: Explore the volcanic landscapes of the Brisas–Valle de las Tumbas sector on a guided outing from Manizales. Access depends on park opening and conditions; the excursion does not include a summit ascent.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Excursión al Nevado del Ruiz
point_of_interest_translations.description: Explora el paisaje volcánico del sector Brisas–Valle de las Tumbas en una salida guiada desde Manizales. El recorrido depende de la apertura y las condiciones del parque; no incluye ascenso a la cumbre.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Passeio ao Nevado del Ruiz
point_of_interest_translations.description: Explore a paisagem vulcânica do setor Brisas–Valle de las Tumbas em um passeio guiado saindo de Manizales. O percurso depende da abertura e das condições do parque; não inclui subida ao cume.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Hot springs near Manizales
point_of_interest_translations.description: Spend a day enjoying hot springs in neighbouring Villamaría, surrounded by mountains and Andean vegetation. Several establishments offer different ways to visit; check services and entry conditions before choosing.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Aguas termales en los alrededores
point_of_interest_translations.description: Dedica una jornada a los baños termales en el vecino municipio de Villamaría, entre montañas y vegetación andina. Hay diferentes establecimientos y modalidades de visita; confirma los servicios y las condiciones de ingreso antes de elegir.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Águas termais nos arredores
point_of_interest_translations.description: Dedique um dia aos banhos termais no município vizinho de Villamaría, entre montanhas e vegetação andina. Há diferentes estabelecimentos e modalidades de visita; confirme os serviços e as condições de entrada antes de escolher.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Guided historic centre walk
point_of_interest_translations.description: Walk through the squares, streets and Republican-era buildings of Manizales with a guide who explains their history and changes over time. The experience usually takes two to three hours; agree on the itinerary and meeting point when booking.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Recorrido guiado por el centro histórico
point_of_interest_translations.description: Recorre a pie las plazas, calles y edificios republicanos de Manizales con un guía que explique su historia y sus transformaciones. La experiencia suele durar entre dos y tres horas; acuerda el itinerario y el punto de encuentro al reservar.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Passeio guiado pelo centro histórico
point_of_interest_translations.description: Caminhe pelas praças, ruas e edifícios da época republicana de Manizales com um guia que conte sua história e suas transformações. A experiência costuma durar de duas a três horas; combine o roteiro e o ponto de encontro ao reservar.
